title: Traffic Sign - Visibility Obstruction
description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report visibility obstructions for stop, yield or one-way signs only. Place all other signs on Traffic Sign - Maintenance (Other). The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 business day.
instructions: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report visibility obstructions for stop, yield or one-way signs only. Place all other signs on Traffic Sign - Maintenance (Other). The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 business day. Please call 311 for more information

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone about an obscured stop, yield, or one-way sign.
actions.why: For a visibility obstruction affecting a stop, yield, or one-way sign. The request must be dispatched, and its saved instructions direct people to call 311.
actions.why_not: This call-in service covers stop, yield, and one-way signs only. If another City traffic sign is obscured, then submit a "Traffic Sign Maintenance (Other)" 311 request instead.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about another obscured City traffic sign.
actions.why: For a nonhazardous visibility obstruction affecting a City traffic sign other than a stop, yield, or one-way sign. The Traffic Sign - Visibility Obstruction instructions direct those signs to traffic-sign maintenance.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Sign Maintenance (Other)"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Sign Maintenance (Other)"
